pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.text: The plan supplies the name, palette, type families and reading-tab motif. This guide adds original book geometry and practical composition rules.
examples.title: Scope

examples.text: Guidance is in English; product copy stays in Spanish. Show “Biblioteca ficticia con lecturas de ejemplo.” once per app page.
examples.title: Language

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Read the guide from identity foundations to working applications. Page numbers refer to this manual, not additional routes in the app.

examples.text: Cover, brand foundations, voice and the Biblioteca Lino logo system.
examples.title: 01–15 · Identity

examples.text: Typography, layouts, color, reading tabs, icons and image-free art direction.
examples.title: 16–29 · Visual language

examples.title: 30–49 · Applications

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Use the reading notebook as the organizing idea. Prioritize full titles, authors and reading progress over stock counts, shelf decoration or SaaS-style promotion.

examples.text: A stable header leads into a typographic summary, active readings and a quieter list of finished books.
examples.title: Tu cuaderno de lectura

examples.text: Title and action share an edge. Search and status controls precede bibliographic cards with a reserved side margin.
examples.title: Tu colección

pages.title: Project purpose
pages.summary: Describe the agreed product purpose, not an invented corporate mission. Keep the identity centered on organizing a fictional personal library and remembering ratings.

examples.text: Biblioteca Lino es un cuaderno digital para organizar tus lecturas y recordar tus valoraciones.
examples.title: Purpose statement

examples.text: Resumen y colección, sin cuentas ni distracciones comerciales.
examples.title: Scope statement

pages.title: Design principles
pages.summary: Treat warmth, clarity and honest feedback as project design principles, not corporate values. Express them through readable paper layouts and confirmed state changes.

examples.text: Pair “Entre tus páginas” with cream space and a serif heading, not a decorative shelf illustration.
examples.title: Warmth

examples.text: Use “Guardar libro” and “Cancelar” rather than vague actions such as “Continuar”.
examples.title: Clarity

examples.text: Show “Guardando” during a request. Reserve “Libro guardado” and olive accents for server-confirmed results.
examples.title: Honesty

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write calm, direct Spanish. Name the action or problem, then offer a useful next step. Avoid technical jargon, recommendations and exaggerated reassurance.

examples.text: Todavía no tienes libros. Añade el primero para empezar tu cuaderno.
examples.title: Empty state

examples.text: No podemos confirmar el cambio. Usa Recuperar cambio para consultar el resultado del mismo intento.
examples.title: Uncertain result

examples.text: Escribe un título de entre 1 y 200 caracteres.
examples.title: Validation

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Open the logo chapter on Quiet Ivory. Present the open book and bookmark without extra emblems; the name is always separate, live typography.

examples.text: The open book introduces the notebook idea; the terracotta bookmark connects it to the reading-tab interaction.
examples.title: Biblioteca Lino

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The symbol uses two balanced pages, an ink fold and one terracotta bookmark. Keep this single geometry across the header, browser icon and application icons.

examples.text: Place the symbol to the left of Biblioteca Lino, aligned to the optical center of the name.
examples.title: Full signature

examples.text: Use the book alone for compact identity slots. Do not replace it with BL, a stock book icon or a simulated cover.
examples.title: Symbol-only use

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Set Biblioteca Lino in Source Serif 4, weight 600, natural case and slightly tight tracking. Use the horizontal lockup as the default header signature.

examples.text: Start with a 32 px symbol, 24 px name and 8 px gap. Keep the complete business name on one line.
examples.title: Header lockup

examples.text: Reduce adjacent navigation spacing before reducing the name. Preserve the logo proportions and 44 px navigation targets.
examples.title: Narrow layout

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Use one tenth of the symbol canvas as the minimum clear space around the lockup. Measure from its outer bounds; navigation, rules and controls stay outside this zone.

examples.text: For a 40 px symbol canvas, keep at least 4 px clear around the full lockup and 16 px before Resumen.
examples.title: Header spacing

examples.text: For a 20 mm symbol canvas, reserve at least 2 mm around Biblioteca Lino. Use more space on covers.
examples.title: Print spacing

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Preserve the symbol’s ink, ivory and terracotta fills. On colored fields, add a Warm Paper support surface so the complete geometry remains visible.

examples.text: Use the original symbol and #332B27 name directly on #F7F1E7.
examples.title: Paper header

examples.text: Use a #F7F1E7 support surface for the symbol and #FFFCF7 for the separately typeset name.
examples.title: Ink cover

examples.text: Keep the mark on paper support. Set Biblioteca Lino in ivory; never recolor the bookmark to make it disappear.
examples.title: Terracotta divider

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Keep the open-book silhouette upright and square in its canvas. The bookmark is part of the mark, not a movable status tab or a loading indicator.

examples.text: Center the original 160 × 160 geometry on a Warm Paper support field.
examples.title: Application icon

examples.text: Cards use the separate three-position margin tab. Do not repeat the full Biblioteca Lino symbol beside every title.
examples.title: Reading-card distinction

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not stretch, rotate, outline, crop or add shadows to the mark. Keep the name in real type and never merge it into the SVG geometry.

examples.text: Do not repeat the symbol as rows of tiny books behind “Tu colección”. The title and author remain the subject.
examples.title: Wrong: decorative shelf

examples.text: Do not replace the open book with an initial in a box or enclose the lockup in an invented certification seal.
examples.title: Wrong: generic badge

examples.text: Use Biblioteca Lino once in the shared header with the original book geometry and clear surrounding space.
examples.title: Correct: quiet signature

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Introduce the type system through a reading phrase, not an alphabet chart. Serif carries identity; sans serif makes everyday interaction clear.

examples.text: Tus lecturas en curso, con su título, autor y valoración.
examples.title: Entre tus páginas

examples.text: Use a spacious serif heading above one short sans-serif line. Align both to the notebook’s left margin.
examples.title: Chapter composition

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Pair Source Serif 4 for the name and headings with Source Sans 3 for controls and functional text. Supplied distributable files cover the selected weights.

examples.text: Un lugar para volver a tus libros.
examples.title: Tu cuaderno de lectura

examples.text: Keep book titles in Source Serif 4. Set author names, labels, notices and buttons in Source Sans 3.
examples.title: Family roles

examples.text: If a font fails to load, use Georgia for serif and system sans-serif for controls. These are fallbacks, not identity fonts.
examples.title: Fallback behavior

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Use Source Serif 4 to give titles literary presence without ornament. Preserve Spanish accents and full book titles; allow wrapping instead of ellipsis.

examples.text: Inés Valdara · Leyendo · Sin valorar
examples.title: La casa de las mareas quietas

examples.text: Use weight 500–600 with natural spacing and comfortable line height. Never condense a long title to force it onto one line.
examples.title: Title setting

pages.title: Weights & styles
pages.summary: Use serif 600 for the name and primary UI titles, 500 for secondary titles, and sans 400 for body copy. Manual display headings may use the supplied 700 rendering weight.

examples.text: Un invierno de papel · Inés Valdara · Valoración: 4 de 5
examples.title: Lecturas terminadas

examples.text: Set Guardar libro in Source Sans 3, 600. Use 400 for help text and 500–600 for concise labels; avoid synthetic bold.
examples.title: Functional emphasis

examples.text: Use upright text for titles and controls. No italic style is assigned; do not simulate italic files or introduce all-caps navigation.
examples.title: Style restraint

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Source Sans 3 supports scanning and form completion. Keep body text and inputs at 16 px; navigation and metadata may use 14 px with sufficient contrast.

examples.text: Escribe parte del título para encontrar un libro.
examples.title: Buscar por título

examples.text: Retain accents in “Valoración” and “Leído”. Display the initial average as 4,5, not 4.5.
examples.title: Spanish details

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Use 40 px page titles on desktop and 32 px on mobile. Keep book titles below page-title scale; distinguish sections through size and spacing rather than heavy boxes.

examples.text: 6 libros · Todos los estados
examples.title: Tu colección

examples.text: Page title → section heading → full book title → author → controls. Use 24 px card titles with 16 px functional text.
examples.title: Reading order

examples.text: Set metric values prominently, with 14 px labels beneath or alongside. Keep Total, Pendientes, Leyendo and Leídos on one shared rhythm.
examples.title: Summary strip

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Use continuous paper, aligned margins and the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48 px spacing scale. Collection cards form three, two and one columns at 1440, 768 and 390 px.

examples.text: Busca un título o elige un estado para recorrer tus libros.
examples.title: Tu colección

examples.text: At 390 × 640, allow up to 96 px for header, 72 px for title/action and 148 px for controls, so a card begins in the first viewport.
examples.title: Small-screen budget

examples.text: Keep Título and Autor full width before Estado and Valoración. Use ordinary panel scrolling; never overlay actions on fields.
examples.title: Dialog rhythm

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Introduce color as paper, ink and a purposeful terracotta action. Keep the palette warm and restrained rather than assigning a bright color to every metric.

examples.text: Tu cuaderno de lectura sits on Warm Paper #F7F1E7, with Reading Ink #332B27 doing most of the visual work.
examples.title: Paper first

examples.text: Reserve Terracotta #98472F for Añadir libro, Guardar libro and selected visual emphasis.
examples.title: Action accent

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Keep every supplied hex unchanged and centrally configurable. Quiet Ivory separates cards from paper; Soft Clay supports metadata. Olive is an additional success-only token.

examples.text: Warm Paper #F7F1E7 · Quiet Ivory #FFFCF7 · Reading Ink #332B27.
examples.title: Base roles

examples.text: Terracotta #98472F · Soft Clay #806B60. Use ink for small text on darkened surfaces; never lower text opacity.
examples.title: Action and secondary text

examples.text: #486343 is the sixth configurable token. Pair it with “Libro guardado” only after confirmation, never with warnings or loading.
examples.title: Confirmed Olive

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Use light tinting only for nonessential hover or selected-area washes. Keep text, focus and control boundaries in solid tokens; do not tint the logo or imply unconfirmed success.

examples.text: A subtle terracotta wash may sit over Quiet Ivory; La casa de las mareas quietas remains solid Reading Ink.
examples.title: Card hover

examples.text: Use solid terracotta for the Guardar libro boundary and focus treatment. Controls and focus need 3:1 contrast; text must meet WCAG AA.
examples.title: Control contrast

examples.text: Set “Sin valorar” in Soft Clay on paper or ivory. Avoid pale opacity treatments that make meaningful metadata disappear.
examples.title: Muted is not disabled

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: The signature device is a tab in a reserved side rail with three labeled positions. It reflects confirmed status and never competes with the title or compresses controls.

examples.text: Pendiente · Leyendo · Leído. Label each rail position once; do not add another status banner above the card.
examples.title: Three positions

examples.text: Show “Guardando” while the tab stays neutral at its previous confirmed position. Errors and conflicts do not move it.
examples.title: Pending change

examples.text: After confirmation, move the tab briefly to its destination. With reduced motion, switch position immediately and retain the text announcement.
examples.title: Confirmed movement

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple functional icons with consistent optical size. Pair ambiguous symbols with visible Spanish labels; warnings need their own icon and text, never a success check.

examples.text: Pair a small pencil with “Editar”. Keep Editar and Eliminar on the card’s lower edge with 44 px targets.
examples.title: Edit action

examples.text: A search icon supports the visible label “Buscar por título”; it does not replace that label.
examples.title: Search field

examples.text: Use a warning symbol beside “No podemos confirmar el cambio”. Reserve an olive check for “Libro guardado”.
examples.title: Feedback

pages.title: Image-free direction
pages.summary: Replace photography with bibliographic composition. Do not use generated imagery, videos, simulated covers or decorative crops; the title and author provide the visual subject.

examples.text: Los mapas del silencio — Clara Neral. Let the complete title wrap on ivory, with a reading tab in the margin.
examples.title: Book specimen

examples.text: Entre tus páginas needs active reading titles, not an image of a desk or an invented recommendation carousel.
examples.title: Section specimen

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Build the reference board from flat paper color, serif rhythm, ink rules and a terracotta bookmark. Suggest a notebook through structure, not distressed textures or ornament.

examples.text: #F7F1E7 field, #FFFCF7 inset and a fine ink rule frame “Donde descansan las semillas”.
examples.title: Material impression

examples.text: Pair a large “Tu cuaderno de lectura” with a compact author line and ample margin.
examples.title: Editorial rhythm

examples.text: No warehouse statistics, ornate bookshelves, faux leather, stock photography or SaaS hero gradients.
examples.title: Exclude

pages.title: Notebook sleeves
pages.summary: Design study: translate packaging into a simple paper sleeve for a reading notebook. Keep it editorial, with no product codes, sales claims or fulfillment language.

examples.text: Use Warm Paper with a narrow terracotta edge. Keep the complete logo away from folds and leave a clear ivory writing area.

pages.summary: Design study: replace pickup wayfinding with clear entry into the two-route app. The shared header leads to the summary, collection and create dialog, not a physical location.

examples.text: Keep Resumen, Libros and Añadir libro reachable by keyboard and touch. Preserve 44 px targets within the compact header.

pages.title: Library controls
pages.summary: Design study: distinguish the terracotta primary action from quiet secondary controls. Keep labels visible, preserve entered values and show validation only with actionable explanations.

examples.text: Completa Título, Autor, Estado y, si quieres, Valoración.
examples.title: Guardar libro

examples.text: Use existing authors, a 1–200 character title, a valid status and an optional integer rating from 1 to 5, independent of status.
examples.title: Form rules

examples.text: Keep Guardar libro activable until a request begins. On invalid submission, retain values, link the error summary and focus the first invalid field.

pages.title: Save confirmation
pages.summary: Design study: replace a receipt with a local confirmation beside the affected book. Show success only after server confirmation; never add a third page or redundant review step.

examples.text: Use Confirmed Olive with the local message and an accessible announcement. Offer Mostrar libro when the confirmed record falls outside the filter.

pages.title: Reading record
pages.summary: Design study: replace rewards with a private reading record. Show status and optional rating without points, streaks, memberships or incentives.

examples.title: El reloj de los domingos

examples.text: Place title first, author second and state beside its tab. Use “Sin valorar” for a missing rating, never an invented zero.

pages.title: Library nameplate
pages.summary: Design study: use a nameplate as a scale study of the identity, not evidence of a physical venue. Keep one lockup with no address, opening hours or service claims.

examples.text: Cuaderno de lectura
examples.title: Biblioteca Lino

examples.text: Use an ivory panel with ink typography and the original symbol. Keep clear space generous and omit ornamental shelf borders.

pages.summary: Design study: show exactly / and /libros. Use Turso-backed readings and metrics; if data is unavailable, show recovery rather than a local-storage or mock-data substitute.

examples.text: Use those figures only for the initial confirmed sample. Lead with Entre tus páginas, then a compact finished list; never hard-code live metrics.

examples.text: Keep search and status in the URL. Use /libros?estado=leyendo for active books; highlight individual records in the collection, without detail routes.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: use the same original geometry for the favicon, app/icon.svg and manifest icons. A paper support field protects visibility; never substitute a template icon.

examples.text: Tu cuaderno de lectura

examples.text: Keep the complete book and bookmark centered in the square canvas. No wordmark, extra border, initials or separate simplified drawing.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: apply the notebook margin to a simple reading sheet. Use a small signature, one serif heading and quiet sans-serif prompts, without implying export functionality.

pages.title: Project cards
pages.summary: Design study: adapt business cards into project introduction cards. Keep the exact name and a concise descriptor; do not invent staff, phone numbers, email addresses or domains.

pages.summary: Design study: replace a gift card with a noncommercial reading note. Do not add amounts, redemption codes or gifting controls; this format explores the editorial identity only.

brandbook.voice: Tranquila, directa y cercana; íntegramente en español. Acciones concretas, errores explicativos y confirmaciones honestas. Una sola nota de biblioteca ficticia por página, sin recomendaciones inventadas ni lenguaje técnico en el flujo ordinario.
